source.title: arXiv 2404.05039: StaccaToe, a single-leg robot that mimics the human leg and toe

independenceNote: Academic StaccaToe leg paper; no CubeMars stake.
methodNote: Backlash measured at the knee actuator output on the assembled leg; torque constants on the authors' dynamometer. The paper states no uncertainty for the backlash: ±1 arcmin is our estimate (rounding the quoted 0.15° alone accounts for ±0.3 arcmin).

rig.torqueSensor: authors' dynamometer (model not given in the text)

claims.source: Manufacturer specification of 0.19° (11.4 arcmin) as quoted by the StaccaToe paper; the AK80-9 V2.0 figure, not confirmed for the V3.0 KV100 on cubemars.com

note: 0.15° backlash at the knee output. The same paper found the measured torque constants of its AK actuators below the specified values.
